svg.desc: A dense model is drawn as one block in which every parameter runs for every token, so memory cost equals compute cost. A Mixture-of-Experts model is drawn as eight expert blocks of which two are active, so all of them sit in memory while only a couple do the work. A table gives real figures: Qwen3-8B is 8B total and 8B active; gpt-oss-20b is 21B total and 3.6B active; gpt-oss-120b is 117B total and 5.1B active; DeepSeek-V3 is 671B total and 37B active.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Total parameters buy memory. Active parameters buy speed.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Mixture-of-Experts model routes each token to a few experts, so the two numbers come apart.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dense - one block, all of it runs

svg.text: So "671B" and "8B" are not on the same scale. Ask which number a comparison is quoting before you believe it.
